stem.en: The round field of view of a microscope is 4 mm wide. A student counts 16 cells along one straight line across it. Estimate the size of one cell in micrometres.

explanation.en: First change the field width to micrometres: 4 mm = 4 x 1000 = 4000 µm. Then divide by the number of cells: 4000 µm / 16 = 250 µm.

hints.en: Then divide by the number of cells.
